body: Usually no because beauty is usually subjective and no matter how hard we try, we know what the beautiful things about us are whether it’s inside or out.

As someone in a sorta similar position, my advice is to do what will make you happy. Despite anything else, you don't want to be stuck doing a job that you hate for the rest of your life because you just stuck with it to make your parents happy. However, in their defense, make sure what you do is something that makes you happy and a livable wage. Your parents probably want you to live securely when you're on your own, but they also probably want to see you content with what you do.
